frame.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production fantasy game UI frame source, standalone reusable hollow frame, not a UI screenshot. Create ONE perfectly front-facing square aged-bronze window frame on actual transparent background, with a completely transparent empty central opening and transparent space outside. Square canvas. Frame occupies about 90% of canvas. Thin continuous shallow sculpted bronze rim about 2% of canvas width, darker inner recessed lip, fine bright upper-left edge and dim lower-right edge. Small rounded corners with elegant integrated folded bronze corner fittings, about 6% of canvas width, controlled proportions; corners seamlessly join the thin straight rails. Quiet handcrafted hand-painted realism, old-world premium game interface. Neutral muted aged bronze and dark walnut edge, subtle worn metal grain, no copper/red/orange cast, no polished yellow gold. The shape is regular and orthographic, no perspective or rotation. Straight horizontal/vertical rails with uniform thickness and quiet centers suitable for slicing/stretching; no broad lighting gradients along the rails. Transparent empty interior must be at least 80% of total canvas area. No leather fill, no words, letters, numbers, logos, icons, jewels, bolts, rivets, gears, filigree, drop shadows outside the frame, glow, scenery, mockup presentation, checkerboard paint or surrounding card. Reference intent: restrained sculpted aged-bronze perimeter of a premium walnut leather fantasy settings window. This is original component artwork only; all interactive content will be rendered separately.

button.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one standalone production game UI button / selection panel source on actual transparent background. A single wide horizontal rectangular handcrafted fantasy UI button, front-facing orthographic, length about four times height, occupying central 90% of canvas width. Modestly rounded clipped corners. Rich dark walnut/chestnut leather interior with extremely fine quiet grain, restrained warm brown neutral undertone, gentle upper-left illumination and shallow sculpted relief. Narrow continuous muted aged-bronze metal rim with a fine inner dark recessed cut and thin antique-gold upper-left lip, slightly crafted integrated corners but no added symbols. The center must stay very quiet and unobstructed for separately rendered ivory text. Straight uniform edge cross sections suitable for nine-slice scaling. This physical control should feel premium, hand-painted and tactile, with subtle worn leather and metal variation; not a flat colored rectangle or vector outline. Bronze should be subdued and patinated, without copper red or orange cast. Small transparent padding around the entire object. No lettering, numbers, labels, logo, pictograms, arrows, rivets, bolts, jewels, filigree, heavy ornament, glow, or cast shadow outside the object. No mockup, no screenshot, no presentation sheet, no other objects. One complete empty button only. Actual transparent background outside its silhouette. A coordinated dark leather button family will be prepared from this artwork, so keep the geometry regular and lighting controlled.

selection.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE original standalone selected navigation/reminder row background for a premium fantasy game UI. A single perfectly front-facing wide horizontal selection plaque, about 5:1 width to height. Small modestly rounded chamfered corners; narrow layered aged-bronze rim, dark inner recessed edge, thin worn antique-gold upper-left glint. Rich neutral dark chestnut leather center with softly burnished bronze-toned relief near its edge; very fine low-contrast grain, quiet broad center for separately rendered ivory labels. A carefully crafted selected panel: subtle folded/tapered bronze corner transitions and handmade narrow edge construction, without symbols or protruding ornaments. Restrained painted realism, tactile shallow depth. It must read as selected through richer worked material and shaped bright rim, not a flat fill or thick yellow outline. Walnut/espresso/dark chestnut/aged bronze; avoid copper, red and orange washes. Soft controlled light from upper left, straight uniform rails suitable for nine-slice scaling. The entire plaque is complete and centered with comfortable actual transparent padding outside; transparent background. No text, labels, numbers, lettering, icon, emblem, arrow, jewels, rivets, bolts, gear, filigree, glow cloud, checkerboard paint, cast shadow outside, scenery, screenshots or presentation board. One selection panel only. Material and silhouette must remain coherent with narrow aged-bronze fantasy window frames and dark leather shallow beveled controls.
